race.comment: FIFTYFIVECHEVY (4) returned with an excellent effort at Moruya two back then raced wide without cover last start at Illawarra Grange in a run worth overlooking. Best form reads well and he should be ready to peak at this stage of the prep. LEICA STORM (1) returned from a 28-month absence with an encouraging third over 1400m at Kembla last time out, looking a chance until the concluding stages. Honest veteran who will take a lot from that run and is right in contention. RED RAGS TO BULLS (7) appreciated the step back to provincial level to break a drought over 1600m here three weeks ago. Up in the weights but can repeat the dose with the confidence now restored. WAKU WAKU (2) has been freshened up since a moderate effort over 1400m at Warwick Farm 38 days ago. The winner of four from 12 so must be respected. UNCLE HARRY (11) stepped up quickly to 1600m last start and raced well. Better for that hit-out and should be about the money again.
